turns.content: A ruthenium methylidene and 1-propene convert an unknown alkene into 1-(prop-1-en-1-yl)-2-vinylcyclopentane. What features of this product point to a ring-opening metathesis precursor?
How are the two alkenyl substituents arranged on the cyclopentane ring, and what does that arrangement imply about the precursor skeleton?
Outline a retrosynthesis consistent with the ring and substituent arrangement.
Use that analysis to infer the precursor framework and explain how the reaction partner supplies one alkenyl group while the adjacent group remains.
What is the full systematic name of starting material A?
Check the assignment by tracing the decisive bond transformation and the subsequent reaction with the reaction partner.
State the identified species and summarize its atom-to-product mapping.
